records.subject: Anything I can help with?
records.body:
Hi Wei,

Hope the first few days with Wrenfield have been smooth. If you'd like, I can help you set up a first project so you're not starting from a blank page.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: Getting your team organized in Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Wei,

A reminder that your Wrenfield workspace is ready whenever you are -- creating one real project is the easiest way to see what it's for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Pioneer Group!
records.body:
Hi Wei,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Pioneer Group* just joined on the starter plan!

Three Wrenfield touches (email:9b9f06a4, email:6a8ff3c0, email:c7dac293) and a held call (calendar:04132757) produced zero customer replies or activity, suggesting low momentum; 8 days left means unaided activation is possible but unlikely.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Wei,

Thanks again for the getting started call last week. Since then your workspace has stayed quiet, so I wanted to check in.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so picking one real piece of work from Pioneer Group and setting it up as a project is usually the quickest way to see the value. When you're ready for the team, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week work? I'm happy to walk through creating that first project with you.

Best,
Chidi
